## Highlights since 0.16.14

- **Overleaf: deleted and renamed folders are cleared.** When a folder is deleted or renamed on Overleaf, sync no longer leaves the old folder behind on your Mac. Lattice clears only folders it has evidence for, and only files a build produced; your own files stay. Thanks to @nipunbatra for the report.
- **macOS Intel builds are back.** v0.16.14 shipped without an Intel build, so "Check for Updates..." on Intel Macs showed an error. This release carries Intel again.

## Notable fixes

- The embedded AI agent is updated to Synara 1.5.1.
